purpose: Close six forward-active P1 source-governance contracts while correcting three legal/provenance semantics and advancing two ASEAN summit occurrences from unscheduled TBC to authoritative month-level forecast windows without inventing exact dates.

WSSRC-MAC-021.governance_backfill_basis: ABS website material is generally CC BY 4.0 and this source has research-validated pilot parser evidence. Copyright reuse and automated production polling remain separate; unrestricted endpoint access is not inferred.

WSSRC-REG2-005.rights_summary: Argentina.gob states that its digital-service content is licensed under Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International unless otherwise indicated.
WSSRC-REG2-005.automation_summary: CC BY 4.0 content reuse does not itself establish unrestricted automated retrieval of the legal/process endpoint.
known_limitations: Law 24.156 Article 26 uses wording equivalent to presentation before 15 September; official budget-process interpretation/practice supports 15 September as the latest civil-date boundary. The boundary does not assert filing time.
WSSRC-REG2-005.governance_backfill_basis: The annual resolution and official budget-process interpretation jointly support the 15 September legal/operational boundary. Argentina.gob content is CC BY 4.0; production automation remains separately unreviewed.

known_limitations: The 31 October record is a legal/operational latest boundary, not the actual parliamentary vote date.
The Treasury explainer contains legacy examples/references; Government Regulation 90/2010 has been revoked and is not used as current authority.
WSSRC-REG-005.governance_backfill_basis: Law 17/2003 Article 15(4) plus current official Treasury APBN-cycle guidance support the end-October legal boundary. Source-specific reuse/automation terms remain unresolved, so verification stays manual and rights-held.

WSSRC-EL-ZA-001.rights_summary: South African Government web terms permit copying/distribution for non-commercial informational or reference purposes and require permission for commercial reuse; this is used conservatively as a government-web benchmark rather than as a COGTA crawler licence.
WSSRC-EL-ZA-001.automation_summary: No production automated-retrieval permission is inferred for the COGTA proclamation endpoint.
WSSRC-EL-ZA-001.governance_backfill_basis: COGTA is authoritative for the gazetted 4 November 2026 local-government election date. Conservative government-web terms support manual factual reference but not commercial reuse or production polling without permission.

WSSRC-INT-021.information_supplied: Singapore MFA's current 2027 high-level-meeting forecast identifies the 50th ASEAN Summit in May 2027 and the 51st ASEAN Summit and Related Summits in November 2027; exact dates are not stated.
known_limitations: The MFA schedule is explicitly a forecast; month and estimated duration do not establish exact summit dates.
Older logistics/procurement windows are not summit date authority.
WSSRC-INT-021.licence_constraints: MFA website materials are protected; commercial reuse requires prior written permission apart from statutory fair dealing.
WSSRC-INT-021.rights_summary: Singapore MFA Terms permit statutory fair dealing but prohibit commercial reproduction/reuse of website material without prior written permission.
WSSRC-INT-021.automation_summary: Public accessibility and official status do not establish a production crawler licence.
WSSRC-INT-021.governance_backfill_basis: The current Singapore MFA notice is authoritative host-government evidence for May/November forecast months only. Website terms do not clear production automation or commercial content reuse.

WSSRC-FIS-023.rights_summary: The Union Budget website policy states that site content may not be reproduced partially or fully without Ministry of Finance permission and requires source acknowledgement when referenced.
WSSRC-FIS-023.automation_summary: No production automated-retrieval grant is identified; the portal remains a manual publication/schedule monitor until a cleared route exists.
WSSRC-FIS-023.governance_backfill_basis: The Budget portal is authoritative for official Budget publications and eventual schedule announcements, but its own Terms say it is not a statement of law. Article 112 authority is separated into WSSRC-FIS-025; no 2027 presentation date is inferred.

new_sources.institution: Legislative Department, Ministry of Law and Justice, Government of India
new_sources.endpoint_role: Constitution of India Article 112 legal basis for annual Union Budget / Annual Financial Statement
new_sources.information_supplied: Article 112 requires the President to cause an Annual Financial Statement to be laid before both Houses of Parliament for every financial year; it establishes recurring constitutional existence, not a 2027 presentation date.
new_sources.recommended_verification_cadence: annual legal-text recheck; recheck after constitutional amendment
known_limitations: Article 112 establishes the Annual Financial Statement requirement but does not prescribe the annual presentation date.
new_sources.notes: Created to separate constitutional legal authority from the Union Budget publication/announcement monitor. No new canonical occurrence or inferred 1 February date is authorised.
new_sources.licence_constraints: NO_UNRESTRICTED_REUSE_OR_AUTOMATION_GRANT_IDENTIFIED; MINIMAL LEGAL FACTUAL METADATA MANUAL REFERENCE ONLY
new_sources.rights_summary: The Legislative Department is the first-order Government of India source for the Constitution. No unrestricted content-reuse licence is inferred in this review; WORLD SIGNALS retains only minimal legal factual metadata and the authoritative reference.
new_sources.automation_summary: Official status and public availability do not establish crawler or production polling permission.
new_sources.rights_review_note: Operational WORLD SIGNALS source-governance classification; not a legal opinion.
new_sources.governance_backfill_basis: Article 112 is direct constitutional authority for the recurring Annual Financial Statement requirement, but not for an annual presentation date. The source is retained as manual legal provenance only.

set.governing_instrument: Law 24.156 Article 26 / Resolution 446/2026 budget formulation process
set.notes: Law 24.156 Article 26 uses wording equivalent to presentation before 15 September; official Argentina budget-process interpretation and practice treat 15 September as the latest civil-date submission boundary. This is not a prediction of the precise filing time.

set.governing_instrument: Law No. 17 of 2003 Article 15(4); current Ministry of Finance APBN-cycle operationalisation
set.notes: Law No. 17 of 2003 Article 15(4) sets the DPR decision no later than two months before the budget year, while current official Ministry of Finance APBN-cycle guidance operationalises enactment at end-October. The 31 October record is a legal-latest boundary, not the actual vote date. Revoked Government Regulation 90/2010 is not used as current authority.

Singapore MFA's current 2027 high-level-meeting forecast places the 50th ASEAN Summit in May 2027 with an estimated five-day duration. The month is authoritative forecast evidence; no exact start/end dates are inferred from duration or older logistics windows.

Singapore MFA's current 2027 high-level-meeting forecast places the 51st ASEAN Summit and Related Summits in November 2027 with an estimated six-day duration. The month is authoritative forecast evidence; no exact start/end dates are inferred from duration or older logistics windows.

Article 112 of the Constitution requires an Annual Financial Statement for every financial year but does not establish the 2027–28 presentation date. The official Budget portal remains the publication/schedule monitor and currently does not provide an authoritative 2027–28 date; no 1 February date is inferred from historical practice.
